_comment: Provenance and integrity record for the model artefacts consumed by Module 1.
These files are NOT trained here. They are produced by scripts/step3_train.py on
the Twinveil-module2 branch and copied in verbatim. Never hand-edit or retype them:
a rounded transcription is what caused the 2026-09 drift this manifest now guards.
The encrypted path divides the logit by POLY_SCALE before evaluating the degree-3
polynomial. P(t) exceeds 0.5 only on 0 < t < poly_positive_root. If the worst-case
scaled logit (sum|w| + |b|) / POLY_SCALE ever reaches that root, labels invert
silently on extreme inputs. Retraining is the realistic way to break this.
